text:
Maria Lopez: Quick q — for tomorrow's 3rd-round micro-panel can we add a 10m buffer between interviews? we're doing 3 back-to-back and need time to swap notes and give the candidate a short break. @Samir Patel @Elena K

Samir Patel: 10m sounds right to me. helps with scribing + notes. are you thinking after each 40m slot or just before the debrief?

Maria Lopez: after each 40m slot. so pattern would be 40/10/40/10/40/20(debrief). makes room to normalize scores.

Elena K: yes please. can we also lock the rubric order? last time people mixed behavioral and system design and scores were all over. Proposed: behavioral -> system design -> coding rubric.

Maria Lopez: noted. proposed order saved. quick ask on scribe: who can take the middle slot debrief notes (so we have consistent anchor)? @Maya or @Jonathan R?

Maya: I can scribe the middle debrief (slot 2). will capture top 3 takeaways + quick parity note.

Jonathan R: happy to scribe the first if that helps. also can run the recording consent line at the top: "we record for debrief purposes only, will not be shared externally".

Samir Patel: tiny logistics: please add 10m buffer as separate calendar items (not just description) so rooms have gap. calendar-bot tends to squash if it's one event.

PeopleOps Bot: calendar-bot created gaps: \n- 2028-11-17T15:00-15:40 (Candidate A)\n- 2028-11-17T15:40-15:50 (Buffer)\n- 2028-11-17T15:50-16:30 (Candidate A continued)\nLinks: https://calendar.company/abc123 (room)\n
Maria Lopez: thanks bot. one rubric clarity — for behavioral anchors, use 1-4 scale with the example prompts in the doc. don't use N/A unless candidate skipped the question.

Elena K: adding a short rubric cheat sheet into the interview doc now. snippet I pasted in thread: \n```\nBehavioral: 1 (no structure) — 4 (clear impact, metrics, tradeoffs)\nSystem design: emphasize capacity, latency, failure modes\nCoding: focus on correctness + test cases, not optimization unless asked\n```\n
Maya: also a note on accessibility — candidate requested captions. we enabled Live Captions in the room and sent consent link.

Maria Lopez: perfect. last nit: post-interview debrief template — please fill "Top strengths", "Top risks", and a single recommended next step (hire/loop/decline). keeps things short.

Jonathan R: agree. will use template. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: small reminder to reviewers — if you hit >5 min late to start, mark the candidate as delayed in the calendar and ping people-ops. we had one no-show sync yesterday and it threw off timing.

Maria Lopez: will do. thanks team — if no other objections I'll finalize calendar + doc by EOD.

Elena K: all good from me.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: send debrief template 10m after last slot ends.

Maria Lopez: done. good luck tomorrow!
